privacy.title: TaskLap Privacy Policy

changesSummary.title: Summary of Changes (July 2026 Revision)
changesSummary.description: This policy has been revised for TaskLap v1.2.0, which introduces an optional account sync feature. The main changes are:
items: Only if you sign in, sync data is now stored in Google Firebase (cloud)
Added account information (identifier and email address via Apple / Google) and synced user content to the information we collect
Added a new "Deleting Your Account and Data" section
If you do not sign in, everything works as before: all data stays only on your device (zero cloud transmission)

keyPoint.title: Important: Sync is optional. Unless you sign in, your data stays only on your device
keyPoint.description: TaskLap works fully locally by default and never sends your data anywhere. Only when you optionally sign in to sync across devices is your sync data stored in Google Firebase. We never collect data for advertising or tracking.

dataCollection.title: 1. Information We Collect
dataCollection.localSubtitle: All users (stored only on your device):
localItems: Completion status, creation and update dates
dataCollection.syncSubtitle: Only if you sign in (stored in the cloud for sync):
syncItems: Account information: your user identifier and email address from Apple or Google Sign-In
Synced user content: tasks, checklists, groups, and some settings

noDataCollection.title: 2. Information We Do Not Collect
noDataCollection.description: We do not collect any of the following information:

dataStorage.title: 3. Where Your Data Is Stored
localItems: All data is stored in a SQLite database on your device
The app works fully offline; an internet connection is not required
dataStorage.cloudSubtitle: In the cloud (only if you sign in):
cloudItems: Sync data is stored in Google Firebase (Firebase Authentication / Cloud Firestore, operated on Google Cloud)
Only the data needed for sync is stored in the cloud
You can edit offline; changes sync when you are back online

dataUse.title: 4. How We Use Your Data
dataUse.description: Data stored in the cloud is used solely to sync your content across your devices.
items: Never sold or shared with third parties

withoutSignIn.title: 5. If You Do Not Sign In
withoutSignIn.description: If you do not sign in, TaskLap works fully locally, just as before. All data is stored only on your device and nothing is ever sent to the cloud. Deleting the app completely removes all data on the device.

accountDeletion.title: 6. Deleting Your Account and Data
accountDeletion.description: You can delete your account at any time from Settings → Sync in the app. Deleting your account removes all of your data stored in the cloud (Firebase).
items: Account deletion removes all your cloud data, including account information and synced content
Data on your device remains after account deletion and stays fully usable offline
If you only sign out, your cloud data is kept and restored when you sign in again

dataSharing.title: 7. Data Sharing
dataSharing.description: We do not share or sell your data to any of the following:
dataSharing.note: We use Google Firebase (Google LLC) as our cloud infrastructure to store sync data. Firebase processes your data only to provide the sync service.

security.title: 8. Security
security.description: Your data is protected as follows:
items: Cloud data is isolated per user; Firestore Security Rules ensure that only you can access your data
All communication is encrypted in transit (HTTPS/TLS)
Data on your device is protected by your device's security settings (passcode, biometrics, etc.)

ads.title: 9. Advertising
ads.description: TaskLap app does not display any advertisements.

ageRestriction.title: 10. Age Requirement
ageRestriction.description: TaskLap app is intended for users aged 13 and above. Users under 13 should use this app with parental consent.

contact.title: 11. Contact
contact.description: If you have any questions about this privacy policy, please feel free to contact us:

policyChanges.title: 12. Policy Changes
policyChanges.description: This privacy policy may be updated in response to changes in legal requirements or additions to app features. When there are significant changes, we will notify you in advance through the app or website. The most recent revision (July 2026) reflects the introduction of the optional account sync feature.

privacy.finalNote: TaskLap respects your privacy with a simple principle: local by default, cloud only when you choose — and you keep full control of your data at all times.

contact.title: Feel free to contact us
contact.subtitle: We welcome your questions, requests, and feedback about TaskLap. We will respond as quickly as possible.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Please check our FAQ before contacting us.

versionHistory.title: Version History
versionHistory.developmentText:
TaskLap is continuously being improved.
We will notify you here whenever there are new features or improvements.

changes.trashDarkMode: Dark mode support for trash page

changes.multiLanguage: Multi-language support (Japanese, English, Chinese, Korean, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese)

changes.todayTab: Added a Today tab for Todos planned for today
changes.scheduledTodos: Added scheduled dates for Todo planning
changes.carryoverReview: Added daily carryover review for unfinished scheduled Todos
changes.todoFilters: Improved Todo filters and date/group editing flows

changes.groupedTodo: Improved Todo and Today views with clearer group sections
changes.groupFocus: Added group menu actions for adding tasks and starting Focus Mode
changes.carryoverFlow: Improved carryover review with a full-screen one-by-one flow
changes.dragStability: Improved empty group visibility and cross-group drag stability

changes.categoryFilters: Added multi-select category filters for Todo and Check Lists
changes.bulkAdd: Added bulk creation from newline-separated pasted text
changes.darkModeContrast: Improved dark-mode selected and highlighted text contrast
changes.compactLists: Compact list rows and translucent navigation show more tasks at once

changes.accountSync: Added account sync (Sign in with Apple / Google)
changes.multiDevice: Tasks, checklists, and groups now sync across your devices
changes.offlineEditing: Edit offline — changes sync automatically when you're back online
changes.conflictResolution: Review and resolve cross-device edit conflicts right in the app

changes.autoSync: Auto sync — changes are now synced to the cloud automatically
changes.inboxDefault: The Inbox group is now always pinned to the top of the list
changes.quickGroupCreate: Create a new group on the spot from task details
changes.syncStability: Improved sync stability and forward compatibility

hero.kicker: For everyone whose todo list never sticks
hero.h1: The to-do app for finishing things.
hero.sub: It's not you — most apps demand too much managing. TaskLap was built around one job: finishing the thing in front of you.
hero.trust: Free · Start without an account · 8 languages
hero.demoDone: Nice work! 🎉 All done for today.
bubbles: I organize more than I actually do
Every trip, the same packing list from scratch
bubblesEmo: I can't even look at it anymore
Maybe paper was fine after all
Set it up perfectly. That was it.

statement.h2: Not an app for managing tasks. An app for finishing them.
statement.sub: Labels, priorities, deadlines, filters — the more you organize, the less you do. So instead of adding features, TaskLap subtracts the hesitation.
statement.h2Top: Not an app for managing tasks.

chapters.title: Deciding what's next eats the whole day.
chapters.body: The more choices, the harder it is to start. Focus Mode shows only the task in front of you — complete or skip, nothing else. Decision fatigue, designed away.

chapters.title: Every time you open it, the backlog glares back.
chapters.body: TaskLap has no red overdue numbers. Leftover tasks get sorted in a quick morning carry-over review, so you start today without dragging yesterday along.

chapters.title: Writing the same packing list from scratch. Again.
chapters.body: Build a checklist once, reset it, use it forever. Morning routines, weekend groceries — next time it's one tap.

chapters.title: You spend more time tidying the app than doing tasks.
chapters.body: No labels, no priorities, no setup maze. No sign-up, even. Open, type, drop it in a group — that's the whole system.

bento.title: No red numbers
bento.body: No overdue badges shaming you into opening the app.

bento.title: No streaks
bento.body: Miss a day, lose nothing. Just start again.

bento.title: Sign-up optional
bento.body: Use it right away, no account needed. Sign in only when you want to sync across devices.

bento.title: Completely free
bento.body: No hidden fees. Every feature included.

bento.title: 8 languages
bento.body: Japanese, English, Korean, German, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Chinese.

bento.title: Light & dark themes
bento.body: Two gentle looks for any time of day.

download.h2: Now, go finish one thing today.
download.sub: TaskLap is free. Download it and start right away.

intro.question: Ever been there?
intro.noMsg: Lucky you…! The rest of this page is for those of us who get buried by our lists. But a lighter to-do app makes easy days even lighter.
intro.bridgeBottom: there's a to-do app for that.
